title: Almost Nobody Knew
about: A quiet love story growing unnoticed during walks and hidden moments around the fair.
description: This track looks back on a relationship that developed almost entirely outside everyone else's attention. To the people around us, we were simply two friends walking through the fair, but between the crowds were longer walks, stolen conversations, hidden paths, and small moments that meant far more than anyone realized. It's about how one of the biggest stories of that summer happened quietly, known almost entirely by the two people living it.
lyrics: The little paths we'd disappear on,
The biggest story of my summer...
No one knew a love story
We stayed out longer than we should,
Still too young to really learn.
Maybe that was part of why
The crowds all came and went,
The fair packed up one day.
Yet the story they never noticed...
